facts.fact: The 2026 state budget (final maps, Ministry of Economy and Finance) appropriates MZN 757,832,010 to CEDSIF, the state financial information systems centre: MZN 657,832,010 operating plus MZN 100,000,000 investment, all domestically financed. Date is the document's published month (2026-01).

systems.country_label: Centro de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas de Informação de Finanças

note: Fact on allocation only; the document has no prior-year figure and no spending.
